claims.claim: NVIDIA reported second-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $96.2 billion.
Second-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue increased 18% from the previous quarter.
Second-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue increased 106% from a year ago.
Data Center revenue was $89.0 billion for the quarter.
Data Center revenue was up 117% from a year ago.
Data Center revenue was up 18% from the prior quarter.
GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins were both 75.0% for the second quarter of fiscal 2027.
GAAP diluted earnings per share were $2.46.
Non-GAAP diluted earnings per share were $2.22.
The company returned approximately $26.0 billion to shareholders through share repurchases and cash dividends during the quarter.
The NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform is ramping into full production with racks running at partners including CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Nebius.
Data Center revenue growth was driven by the ramp of the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform into full production.
claims.note: Causal attribution not in the release. The release lists the Vera Rubin production ramp as a Data Center highlight but never identifies it as the driver of the 117% year-over-year Data Center revenue growth.

claims.claim: NVIDIA Spectrum-6 switch systems, supporting both pluggable and co-packaged optics as part of the Vera Rubin platform, are arriving across the world's gigascale AI factories.

NVIDIA announced strategic partnerships to establish independent compute financing platforms with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital for AI infrastructure buildout.
Edge Computing revenue was $7.2 billion.
Edge Computing revenue was up 13% from the previous quarter.
Edge Computing revenue was up 27% from a year ago.
NVIDIA partnered with Microsoft to reinvent the Windows PC with NVIDIA RTX Spark.
Edge Computing revenue was supported by the partnership with Microsoft to reinvent the Windows PC with NVIDIA RTX Spark.
claims.note: Causal attribution not in the release. The Microsoft/RTX Spark partnership is listed as an Edge Computing highlight, but the release does not say it supported or contributed to the segment's revenue.

claims.claim: For the third quarter of fiscal 2027, revenue is expected to be $108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%.
GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins are expected to be 74.0%, plus or minus 50 basis points, for the third quarter of fiscal 2027.
NVIDIA is not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China in its third-quarter fiscal 2027 outlook.
As of the end of the second quarter, approximately $99.0 billion remained under the share repurchase authorization.
The next quarterly cash dividend is $0.25 per share, payable October 1, 2026 to shareholders of record on September 10, 2026.
For the full year fiscal 2027, NVIDIA expects GAAP and non-GAAP tax rates to be between 16.0% and 18.0%, excluding any discrete items and material changes to its tax environment.
The $500 billion third-party capital mobilization is subject to definitive agreements with the financial institutions.
The compute financing partnerships represent a significant expansion of the AI infrastructure financing ecosystem.
claims.note: Analyst characterization. The release describes the partnerships and the capital figure but makes no claim about their significance to the financing ecosystem.

claims.claim: There have been recent geopolitical developments bearing on NVIDIA's China Data Center compute revenue.
claims.note: Outside knowledge. The release states only that no China Data Center compute revenue is assumed in the outlook; it gives no reason and mentions no geopolitical developments.

claims.claim: NVIDIA has a global footprint.
claims.note: Not stated in the release. The release references specific international partnerships (Korea, Japan, Europe) but makes no general assertion about a global footprint.

claims.claim: SpaceXAI will deploy NVIDIA Vera CPUs to accelerate its next generation of agentic AI applications.
NVIDIA launched the NVIDIA DSX platform.
